messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I was in better bike shape last year, and had more ski-time on my legs.

output.original_text: I was in better bike shape last year, and had more ski-time on my legs.
output.joy: I loved how I was in such great bike shape last year, and I had so much ski-time on my legs!
output.sadness: I remember being in better bike shape last year, and I really had more ski-time on my legs then.
output.fear: I was in better bike shape last year, but now I’m afraid I won't keep up, and I had so much more ski-time on my legs back then.
output.anger: It’s frustrating that I was in better bike shape last year, and I had so much more ski-time on my legs!
output.surprise: I was shocked to realize I was in better bike shape last year, and I actually had more ski-time on my legs!
output.disgust: It's disappointing to see that I was in better bike shape last year, and I had so much more ski-time on my legs then.
